description: Thunderbird's own add email account page, driven by Voice Companion, and a check for new mail in one folder. Never reads or changes accounts, passwords or settings.

functions.name: openAccountSetup
functions.description: Open Thunderbird's add email account page and fill in the address and name. Resolves to {opened, prefilled}.

functions.name: setupPage
functions.description: The add account page's title, messages and main button. Resolves to {open, title, notes, button, canContinue, needsPassword}.

functions.name: setupContinue
functions.description: Press the add account page's main button. Resolves to {pressed}.

functions.name: fillPassword
functions.description: Put a password into the add account page's password box. Resolves to {filled}.

functions.name: showSetup
functions.description: Bring Thunderbird to the front. Resolves to {shown}.

functions.name: captureSignIn
functions.description: For this many seconds (0 stops), hand Thunderbird's web browser sign-in address to Voice Companion. Resolves to {capturing}.

functions.name: takeSignIn
functions.description: The sign-in address handed over, once. Resolves to {url, where}.

functions.name: getNewMail
functions.description: Ask the mail server for new messages in one folder now, as when the folder is opened. Resolves to {checked, offline}.
